page.overview:
Who is Abagga Creel?

Abagga Creel was a female Corellian businesswoman who resided on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.

By the time following the Battle of Yavin, Abagga Creel was the assistant of the businessman Ral Mundi, head of Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium, in Coronet City. an important shipment ordered by Ral Mundi disappeared during its transports, putting the company on the verge of ruin. Creel thus worked with a spacer to find information concerning the missing shipment.

Around the same time, Abagga Creel donated her luxury SoroSuub Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 named Spirit of Corellia to the service of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Abagga Creel was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts,
